item.description:
# RunHuddle 0.15.2
- Saved work now opens in the main workspace with a list and detail pane. Start a fresh Codex, Claude Code, or Copilot session from a reviewed saved summary. - Generate handoffs or draft work summaries for multiple selected sessions. Review generated summaries before saving them to the library. - Session context menus now include handoff generation and archiving. List icons show generated handoffs, saved work, and observed compaction counts, with a collapsible icon guide. - Track observed compactions from available Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot history. Counts describe recorded events, not guaranteed lifetime totals. - Choose Terminal, iTerm2, or Ghostty and a new tab or window for session launches. Terminal tab targeting handles changed window identities and slower shell startup while refusing ambiguous targets. - Renaming an active session can update its uniquely matched Terminal tab title. - Consolidated sidebar controls into Settings with General, Connections, Terminal, and Notifications tabs. - Temporary project folders are grouped under Temporary / other in filters.
Terminal.app tab creation requires Accessibility permission. iTerm2 and Ghostty use native scripting; Ghostty requires 1.3 or later with AppleScript enabled.
Validation includes Swift and Python tests, simulated Terminal tab targeting, standalone packaging, and updater checks. Live terminal interaction is not automatically tested.
